scores.label: A
scores.note: All fit grammatically. 'kind' is a plain near-synonym; 'tender' and 'mild' are weak for character; 'meek', 'innocent' and 'harmless' drift from gentleness toward submissiveness, innocence or lack of danger. 'soft-hearted' and 'good-natured' are the strongest but sit at 4 and 9. No zeros.
